title: Issue with .net 10
author: 7h3Cub3
body_snippet: Hello, Im trying to use the nightly version but either the zip or the msi keep asking for .net 10 to be installed, but i already have it (all 3 flavors + sdk's) and i have several .net 10 app that have no problem running, i think there is an issue with the version check, it seems to require v10.0.0 but can never find it, i tried to rollback to 10.0.0 but with no success, current version is 10.0.9

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the detailed runtime list — that actually narrows it down.

The dialog means the build you launched is **framework-dependent** (it expects the .NET Desktop Runtime to be installed and resolved at launch), and the host isn't resolving your installed 10.0.9 even though `dotnet --list-runtimes` clearly shows it. comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks — the `runtimeconfig.json` and `DOTNET_ROOT` output actually flipped the diagnosis, and my earlier guess was wrong.

That dialog is **not** the .NET host's "framework not found" dialog — it's **mRemoteNG's own** pre-launch check. The check only reads one registry value:

```
HKLM\SOFTWARE\dotnet\Setup\InstalledVersions\<arch>\sharedhost\Version
```

That value is **not** the runtime-resolution result, and it's missing on some perfectly valid installs (e.g. when a runtime was laid down by ...
